parts.html: The K-03 standard model is a contemporary straight kitchen with a freestanding island, pairing deep black with the texture of wood. Sleek fronts and crisp geometry make it a standout feature of the interior.
The contrast between black surfaces and wood decor looks especially good in an open-plan kitchen and living room, whether in an apartment or a private house.
The porcelain stoneware countertop is practical for everyday cooking and underscores the model’s contemporary character.
The 7 linear meters along the wall accommodate built-in appliances, a work surface, and spacious cabinets, while the island adds another work zone.
Doors on Hettich soft-close hinges and Atira Hettich drawers open and close smoothly.
We make the K-03 to fit your kitchen — with a different cabinet arrangement, additional storage systems, or materials chosen to match your interior.
